text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":19,"why":"Patient described symptoms of cough, cold, headache, chills, and muscle aching."},{"i":1,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":14,"why":"Patient stated the symptoms started a few days ago, around the start of the weekend."},{"i":2,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":25,"why":"Patient described a dry cough without sputum, and denied bringing up blood."},{"i":3,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":29,"why":"Patient explicitly stated no shortness of breath."},{"i":4,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":37,"why":"Patient mentioned taking paracetamol."},{"i":5,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":40,"why":"Patient stated being a diabetic for a few years and taking metformin, and having high blood pressure and taking lisinopril."},{"i":6,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":40,"why":"Patient mentioned taking metformin and lisinopril."},{"i":7,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":63,"why":"Doctor's assessment that the symptoms are consistent with a viral infection."},{"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":72,"why":"Doctor advised the patient to use Night Nurse and Day Nurse if there are any changes in symptoms."},{"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":68,"why":"Doctor advised the patient to call back if symptoms persist for more than three weeks or if there is breathlessness or wheezing."}]}
